points: The timer starts when you press Start and keeps running, even if you close the page.
Each answer is saved as you choose it. If your connection drops or you refresh, you can carry on from where you were.
You can move between questions and change answers until you submit.
When the time ends, the answers you have saved are submitted automatically.
Answer on your own, without help. Your result appears as soon as you submit.
overview.sampleNote: The questions in this demonstration are samples. Real safety assessments must be reviewed by qualified course owners before use.
